nodes.description: Ownable.owner: privileged address controlling onlyOwner functions; written from msg.sender in constructor and from wallet in URUNToken constructor.
ERC20Basic.totalSupply: total token supply, reduced by BurnableToken.burn.
BasicToken.balances: mapping(address => uint256) of token balances mutated by transfer, transferFrom and burn.
StandardToken.allowed: nested mapping of allowances written by approve and decremented in transferFrom.
URUNToken.name: token name set in constructor.
URUNToken.symbol: token symbol set in constructor.
URUNToken.decimals = 18, used as exponent in the initial supply multiplication.
SafeMath.mul(a,b): checked multiplication, used for the initial supply computation.
SafeMath.div(a,b): division helper.
SafeMath.sub(a,b): checked subtraction used for balance, allowance and supply reductions.
SafeMath.add(a,b): checked addition used for balance increases.
Ownable constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == owner) guarding privileged functions.
transferOwnership(address): onlyOwner function that reassigns the owner state variable.
BasicToken.transfer(address,uint256): moves balances of msg.sender to _to using SafeMath add/sub.
BasicToken.balanceOf(address): reads balances mapping.
StandardToken.transferFrom(address,address,uint256): spends allowance and moves balances using SafeMath.
StandardToken.approve(address,uint256): writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
StandardToken.allowance(address,address): reads allowed mapping.
BurnableToken.burn(uint256): onlyOwner function that destroys msg.sender balance and totalSupply.
URUNToken fallback function payable that immediately reverts any incoming ether.
URUNToken constructor: sets owner, totalSupply via mul, name, symbol and initial wallet balance.
getTokenDetail(): view helper returning name, symbol and totalSupply.
msg.sender used to set the owner in the Ownable constructor.
msg.sender used as source account in BasicToken.transfer.
msg.sender used as spender in transferFrom and as allowance owner in approve.
msg.sender used as the burned account in BurnableToken.burn.
initialSupply.mul(10 ** uint256(decimals)) in URUNToken constructor: arithmetic computation of total supply.
balances[msg.sender].sub(_amount) and balances[_to].add(_amount) in BasicToken.transfer: arithmetic on user-controlled amount.
balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) and totalSupply.sub(_value) in BurnableToken.burn: arithmetic supply reduction.
balances[_from].sub(_amount) and allowed[_from][msg.sender].sub(_amount) in StandardToken.transferFrom: arithmetic on allowance and balances.
owner = newOwner reassignment in transferOwnership: privileged access-control sensitive state write.
